correctness.rationale: Spectral identity A_epsilon^2=(t^2+epsilon^2)I gives exact eigenvalues/projectors; their difference formulas follow by Frobenius trace. Uniform bounded density and continuity at zero justify dominated convergence for subcritical/supercritical powers, split-domain log asymptotics at p=1 and q=1/2, and positive finite coupled-level integrals. Centered-mean terms are lower order by explicit O(epsilon log(1/epsilon)) and O(epsilon^2 log(1/epsilon)) bounds. Uniform-density formulas are integrated exactly. Standalone standard-library checker passed 55 checks; these are not treated as proofs of limits.

value.rationale: A mathematically natural crossing normal form yields a complete two-critical-index moment phase diagram and quantified variance asymmetry for MLMC corrections of top eigenvalues versus individual eigenspaces. The sharp positive constants and logarithmic boundaries reveal nonuniform gap sensitivity and provide a benchmark for error models and sample allocation. Neither a general operator theorem nor a claim that full-cluster projectors fail is made.
